* IkeSkPayload represents the common information of an Encrypted and Authenticated Payload and an * Encrypted and Authenticated Fragment Payload. * *

It contains other payloads in encrypted form. It is must be the last payload in the message. * It should be the only payload in this implementation. * *

Critical bit must be ignored when doing decoding. * * @see RFC 7296, Internet Key Exchange * Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2)
